problem_statement: Return True if n is a positive integer power of 2 (1, 2, 4, 8, ...), otherwise False. n is any Python integer (excluding bool).
valid_input_domain: Return True if n is a positive integer power of 2 (1, 2, 4, 8, ...), otherwise False. n is any Python integer (excluding bool).
bug_explanation: The faulty solution uses while n >= 1 instead of while n > 1, so the loop continues when n reaches 1 and returns False for all powers of 2.
